output.content:
**No feasible recipe — record `no_feasible_recipe`.** None of the twelve allowed pressure/shelf pairs can hold the returned vial-bottom temperature at or below the critical −36.0 °C: the coldest corner of the candidate grid (0.05 Torr, −25 °C shelf) peaks at −32.55 °C, 3.45 °C above the limit, and every other pair is warmer in shelf setpoint and/or chamber pressure. The only pair that fits inside the whole-batch equipment line (0.2 Torr, −25 °C) still runs 7.10 °C over on product temperature.

Native LyoPRONTO simulations run (six of twelve pairs; product area 16,000 vials × 3.14 cm² = 5.024 m², derived; equipment capacity = −0.182 + 11.7 × P_Torr kg/h, from the case record; all six dried to 100% within the 60 h horizon):

| Pair (Torr / °C shelf) | Complete drying | Max returned bottom T | vs −36.0 °C (derived) | Whole-batch max rate (derived) | Line capacity | Equipment margin (derived) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0.05 / −25 | 23.99 h | −32.55 °C | 3.45 °C over | 1.56 kg/h | 0.40 kg/h | 1.15 kg/h over |
| 0.1 / −5 | 9.84 h | −23.31 °C | 12.69 °C over | 3.18 kg/h | 0.99 kg/h | 2.19 kg/h over |
| 0.2 / −25 | 34.58 h | −28.90 °C | 7.10 °C over | 0.99 kg/h | 2.16 kg/h | 1.17 kg/h within |
| 0.2 / −5 | 9.33 h | −21.13 °C | 14.87 °C over | 3.31 kg/h | 2.16 kg/h | 1.16 kg/h over |
| 0.1 / +10 | 6.62 h | −19.20 °C | 16.80 °C over | 4.53 kg/h | 0.99 kg/h | 3.54 kg/h over |
| 0.2 / +10 | 6.00 h | −17.00 °C | 19.00 °C over | 5.00 kg/h | 2.16 kg/h | 2.84 kg/h over |

The fastest pair overall (0.2 Torr, +10 °C, 6.00 h) violates both constraints. The two constraints also pull in opposite directions: holding temperature needs the coldest corner, which demands 1.56 kg/h of whole-batch removal where the line at 0.05 Torr provides only 0.40 kg/h; fitting the line needs 0.2 Torr with a cold shelf, which still warms the vial bottom to −28.9 °C.

Exclusion of the six pairs I did not simulate (0.05/−15, 0.05/−5, 0.05/+10, 0.1/−25, 0.1/−15, 0.2/−15) is an inference, not solver output: across the runs, raising shelf temperature or chamber pressure always warmed the returned bottom temperature, and the coldest allowed combination already exceeds the limit, so no unsimulated pair can satisfy it either.

What I could not check:
- The save step did not run — the tool budget ended before `lyopronto_record_result` could be called, so nothing has been recorded and no simulation result references were attached. The outcome to record is `no_feasible_recipe`, with the six native simulations from this turn as support.
- Maxima are over returned solver nodes only; the case record itself states there is no continuous-maximum guarantee, so a sharper peak between nodes cannot be excluded.
- This is an authored simulator case (synthetic example, from the case's own metadata), not experimental validation: the drying times and temperatures are native LyoPRONTO 1.2.0 outputs, and nothing here measures or infers a real drying outcome.
